title: Pattern and mirror UI: setup tree folder node, inspector panel, per-copy toggle, and viewport preview

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## Goal

Add user interface controls for pattern and mirror folders in the setup browser tree, the inspector panel, and the 3D viewport. Depends on the pattern folder, mirror folder, and circular pattern sub-issues of `#2938`.

## Scope

- **Browser tree (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_tree.rs`, `tree_menu.rs`):**
  - Show each pattern or mirror folder as a collapsible group under its setup's `Operations` section, with its member operations indented beneath it.
  - Add context-menu actions to create a pattern or mirror folder, add or remove operations, suppress or unsuppress the folder, reorder it, and delete it (ungrouping members).
- **Inspector panel (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/`):**
  - Add a pattern and mirror settings page for mode (Linear, Grid, Circular, Mirror), count, spacing, angle step, mirror plane, copy order (`ByTool` / `ByPart`), and mirror cut direction (`PreserveClimb` / `GeometricMirror`).
  - Show an instance list so the user can toggle individual copies on or off (for example, to skip a clamp position) and see any copy-level verification refusal.
- **Viewport preview (`crates/ui/src/`):** Draw replicated toolpaths for all enabled copies and visually dim disabled copies.
- **Command law:** Dispatch every state change through the undoable commands in `crates/app/src/commands/`; write no ECS fields directly from `crates/ui/` (AGENTS.md "Everything Is a Command" and `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`).

## Done means

UI behaviour and layout tests (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/`) create a pattern folder, move an operation into it, toggle one copy off, inspect a copy-level gate warning, verify all controls dispatch undoable commands, and update `page_layout.rs` and `structural.rs` without touching release-lane snapshot PNGs.

Part of #2938
